name: Fair Futures coaching for youth in foster care
org: NYC Administration for Children's Services (ACS) and Fair Futures
what_you_do: A coach, tutor or specialist gives one-on-one help with school, career readiness, housing and life skills. You can sign up for a coach online.
who_can_apply: Youth in foster care and youth who have left foster care in New York City, from 6th grade through age 26.
pay_detail: Not a job. A cost is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can sign up any time.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Sign-up for Coaching form on the ACS Fair Futures page, or call 212-676-8609. Your foster care agency may also help.
notes: Also open to younger kids. Support, not a paid job. Ask your coach about paid internships.
